title: Buy a Home or Build Your Wealth? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Jillionaire Dylan is 23, lives at home, works two jobs, and has managed to save $100,000. So, what should he do with it? Jill and Mark weigh in on whether he should buy property, invest his cash, or keep saving—and why buying real estate just for the sake of owning it might not be the smartest move.
